#  41414 - Hydrology & Hydraulics Modulübersicht  
|  Module Number:   | **41414 - module is no longer offered from WS 2023/24**  |  
| --- | --- |  
| Module Title:  | **Hydrology & Hydraulics**  |  
|  Hydrologie & Hydraulik   |  
| Department:  |  Faculty 2 - Environment and Natural Sciences   |  
| Responsible Staff Member:  | 
  * Prof. PD Dr.-Ing. habil. Molkenthin, Frank 

 |  
| Language of Teaching / Examination:  | English  |  
| Duration:  | 1 semester  |  
| Frequency of Offer:  |  Every winter semester   |  
| Credits:  |  
| Learning Outcome:  | Understanding hydrological processes in catchments and hydraulic processes in channels, rivers and pipes. Basic hydrological and hydraulic modelling skills.  |  
| Contents:  | Hydrology: hydrological cycle, precipitations measurements and analysis, evaporation analysis, rainfall-runoff analysis, climate change impacts, urban hydrology.Open Channel Hydraulics: Uniform flow in channels and pipes, steady-state and unsteady flow, non-uniform flow in channels and pipes, hydraulic structures, sediment transport.Exercises: analytic solutions, manual calculations and numerical modelling of river flow and hydraulic structures.  |  
| Recommended Prerequisites:  | None  |  
| Mandatory Prerequisites:  | None  |  
| Forms of Teaching and Proportion:  | 
  * Lecture / 4 Hours per Week per Semester 
  * Exercise / 2 Hours per Week per Semester 
  * Self organised studies / 90 Hours 

 |  
| Teaching Materials and Literature:  | see https://euroaquae.tu-cottbus.de  |  
| Module Examination:  | Continuous Assessment (MCA)  |  
| Assessment Mode for Module Examination:  | 
  * Assignments (20%)
  * Written (120 min) and oral (30-45 min) examination (80%)

The form and weighting of partial exams are bindingly determined in the first course weeks.  |  
| Evaluation of Module Examination:  | Performance Verification – graded  |  
| Limited Number of Participants:  | None  |  
| Part of the Study Programme:  | 
  * no assignment

 |  
| Remarks:  | EuroAquae module: EA-1.2  |  
| Module Components:  | 
  * 240627 Lecture Hydrological modelling
  * 240628 Lecture/Exercise Open Channel Hydraulics

 |  
| Components to be offered in the Current Semester:  | 
  * no assignment

 |
